title: Skipass Madness After Christmas

controls.action: Carve left or right; the turn rate is limited by the carving radius at speed
Snowplough to brake; across the slope it becomes a hockey stop
Pole push on flats and from a standstill; on the title, toggle the MAESTRO steering assist
Select the piste and start; retry after a run
Start from the title; return to the title

credits: Built for the PRG32 RISC-V educational console
Original code, procedural 2.5D renderer, procedurally drawn sprites, font, SID-like music and effects
Piste names, codes and altitudes are inspired by the public Roccaraso / Alto Sangro piste map; geometry is an arcade interpretation, not a navigation aid
No third-party code, art, music or assets were used
